#### Import packages

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("curl")
```

#### Load the datasets

```{r}
base_url <- "https://github.com/rforbiodatascience26/group_21_project/raw/main/data/_raw/"
file_names <- c(
  "77_cancer_proteomes_CPTAC_itraq.csv",
  "clinical_data_breast_cancer.csv",
  "PAM50_proteins.csv"
)
```

```{r}
proteomes <- read_csv(str_c("../data/", file_names[1]))
clinical  <- read_csv(str_c("../data/", file_names[2]))
pam50     <- read_csv(str_c("../data/", file_names[3]))
```
